decisions.scope: Repository organization across CLI, ESLint plugin, tests, scripts, documentation, and CI support
decisions.decision: This repository uses dedicated config/ and types/ ownership across every package and support subsystem. Constants are grouped by behavior under config/; types are under types/. Shipped configuration assets stay under packages/cli/configurations/ and parsing and schemas stay under parsers/ owners. This overrides diagram recommendations to delete config/ and types/. Consumer repositories have no dedicated-folder requirement.
evidence: Explicit user corrections in this conversation

decisions.decision: The current user plan requires four test directories: cli, plugin, tools, and packages. Config and types mirror their behavioral owners, and the shared harness stays flat. Scripts own suite and registry orchestration. This supersedes the inherited five-family decision.
evidence: The user’s implementation plan in this conversation

decisions.scope: Coverage levels, automatic applicable configurations, and native rule generation
decisions.decision: Recommended and all are the only developer-facing coverage levels. Remove opt-in selection fields, prompts, and extra_checks without replacing them. Security, duplication, and licenses follow repository applicability and the chosen level. Remove Vulture entirely. Native-tool configuration syntax remains generated from these two levels. Retain legitimate prerequisites.
evidence: User implementation plan: Finish all findings with only recommended and all, Decisions.

decisions.scope: Automatic applicable configuration selection and manual language/framework overrides
decisions.decision: Retain gspot add/remove, init --configurations, and authored configuration lists for manual language and framework overrides. Remove opt-in check controls such as security, duplication, and licenses flags. This clarifies recommended-and-all: these remain the only check-coverage levels; language/framework overrides remain project configuration.
evidence: User reply to the pending scope clarification: Keep manual language/framework overrides; remove opt-in check controls only.

Implementation: private ownership selections distinguish language/framework additions and removals from automatic detection. Init flags, authored lists, and add/remove remain available; no public selection setting is added. Source: lifecycle/configuration-overrides.ts, lifecycle/reconcile.ts, commands/configurations.ts, and init prepare/write owners.

implementationBatches.overlapPolicy: Each starting record retains its ID and original quotation. Overlapping records appear in every applicable batch. Batch assignment does not close a finding. Second-pass slice corrections precede area and main-summary reconciliation.
